primary.title: Gold loans are becoming the biggest driver of consumer borrowing? Here's what RBI FSR report says
primary.summary: Gold loans have become India's fastest-growing retail credit, recording a CAGR of 42.4% since March 2024, nearly double the 23% growth in non-housing retail loans.
